title: Exascale Multi-Task Graph Foundation Models for Imbalanced, Multi-Fidelity Atomistic Data
abstract: arXiv:2604.15380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present an exascale workflow for atomistic graph foundation models using HydraGNN. Multi-task learning enables joint training across 16 heterogeneous first-principles datasets representing over 467 million unique structures (over 544 million cumulative branch records) and covering 85+ elements. A shared graph neural network backbone with dataset-specific prediction heads accommodates the strongly imbalanced, multi-source, multi-fidelity corpus, supported by scalable ADIOS2/DDStore data management. Composition-conditioned weighting combines source-specific predictions into a single deployable model. Six large-scale hyperparameter optimization campaigns, followed by resource-aware continual training on 2,048 Frontier nodes, identify PaiNN as the lead architecture under a fixed computational budget. translated_title: 面向不平衡、多保真度原子级数据的百亿亿次多任务图基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于HydraGNN的百亿亿次（exascale）原子级图基础模型工作流。多任务学习实现了跨16个异构第一性原理数据集的联合训练，这些数据集包含超过4.67亿个独特结构（累计超过5.44亿条分支记录），涵盖85种以上元素。共享的图神经网络骨干网络结合针对各数据集的专用预测头，能够适应高度不平衡、多来源、多保真度的数据语料库，并由可扩展的ADIOS2/DDStore数据管理提供支持。基于成分条件的加权机制将各数据源专用的预测结果融合为单个可部署的模型。通过六次大规模超参数优化活动，以及在2,048个Frontier节点上进行的资源感知持续训练，在固定计算预算下确定PaiNN为最优架构。我们在Frontier、Aurora和Perlmutter超级计算机上评估了可扩展性，并表征了模型在十二个下游任务上的迁移能力。
tldr: 本文提出了基于HydraGNN的百亿亿次多任务图基础模型工作流，通过共享图神经网络骨干联合训练16个异构第一性原理数据集（超4.67亿个结构），在Frontier等顶尖超算平台上实现可扩展训练，并确定PaiNN为最优架构。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an exascale multi-task graph foundation model workflow based on HydraGNN, which jointly trains on 16 heterogeneous first-principles datasets containing over 467 million structures using a shared graph neural network backbone, demonstrates scalability on leading supercomputers including Frontier, and identifies PaiNN as the lead architecture.
